global_rules: Maintain dark theme but soften backgrounds (use zinc/slate instead of pure black).
Replace robotic monospace with clean sans-serif for UI, keeping mono only for tabular numbers.
Add subtle elevation/depth (borders + soft shadows) instead of flat 1px harsh borders.
Use a sophisticated corporate accent color (Blue) instead of aggressive hacker green.
Update UI.jsx, AppShell.jsx, and App.css primarily.

typography.primary_font: Geist, Inter, or Plus Jakarta Sans
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono

sidebar.structure: Grouped with section headers. Collapsed by default on mobile.
sidebar.group_header: text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-zinc-500 mb-2 px-3 mt-4
sidebar.item_default: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-100 hover:bg-zinc-800/50 transition-colors
sidebar.item_active: flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-zinc-100 bg-zinc-800 shadow-sm border border-zinc-700/50

topbar.structure: Brand mark (left) + Global Search (center) + Notification Bell & User Chip (right)
topbar.style: h-14 border-b border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950/80 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between px-4 lg:px-8
topbar.user_chip: flex items-center gap-2 pl-3 pr-2 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-sm

components.card: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden
components.stat_tile: p-5 bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg flex flex-col gap-1. Value uses mono font (text-2xl font-medium text-zinc-100). Label is text-sm text-zinc-400.
components.table: w-full text-sm text-left. th: text-xs font-medium text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4 border-b border-zinc-800. td: py-3 px-4 border-b border-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-300.
components.pill: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border
components.button_primary: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white shadow-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 focus:outline-none
components.button_secondary: bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-zinc-100 border border-zinc-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-500/50 focus:outline-none
components.input: w-full bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500/50 focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors placeholder:text-zinc-600

screen_mocks.name: Client Dashboard
screen_mocks.description: Left sidebar displays grouped navigation (Workspace, Send, Audience, etc.) with small uppercase headers. Main content area has a greeting header using sans-serif. Below are 4 Stat Tiles showing Wallet Balance (in JetBrains Mono), SMS Sent, Delivery Rate, and Active Campaigns. Below that is a 'Recent Activity' Table inside a card with an 8px radius and subtle borders.

screen_mocks.name: Admin Settings Hub
screen_mocks.description: Sidebar shows Configuration > Settings hub active state (bg-zinc-800). Header features a breadcrumb and an overline label 'CONFIGURATION'. The main area uses a Bento-style grid of Cards for different settings (Security, Billing, Branding). Each card has a Lucide icon in a soft blue circular background, title, and muted description.

screen_mocks.name: Bulk Send Composer
screen_mocks.description: A focused wizard-like form. A top bar shows steps. The main form is housed in a central card with an 8px radius. Inputs have zinc-800 borders, focusing to ring-2 blue-500/30. The message textarea has a character count in mono font. A primary blue CTA 'Review Campaign' sits at the bottom right.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update /app/frontend/src/components/UI.jsx, AppShell.jsx, and App.css to match these styles.
Do NOT replace UI.jsx entirely with raw shadcn components if it requires rewriting page logic. Update the styling inside UI.jsx to match these new corporate guidelines.
Implement the sidebar grouping logic in the AppShell.jsx or relevant navigation component.
Switch font families in index.css or App.css (import Geist, Inter, or Plus Jakarta Sans for UI, and JetBrains Mono for numbers).
Remove all pure black (#0A0A0A) backgrounds and replace with zinc-950 and zinc-900 surfaces.
Remove all heavy font-mono classes from standard text, reserving them ONLY for numbers/stats/code.
CRITICAL: Preserve every single `data-testid` across all files to maintain E2E test passing.
Use lucide-react for all icons, removing any emoji icons.
